description: Defines the DecodeBuffer class and DecodeBufferSubset class for decoding HTTP/2 frames, providing primitives for reading various integer types from a byte buffer, with support for testing and buffer management.

classes.name: DecodeBuffer
classes.description: Provides primitives for decoding integer types from a byte buffer, intended for decoding HTTP/2 frames.

classes.name: DecodeBufferSubset
classes.description: A subclass of DecodeBuffer used for decoding a specific subset of a buffer, ensuring safe cursor management within a known data segment.

methods.name: DecodeBuffer(const char* buffer, size_t len)
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer pointers with raw data and length.

methods.name: DecodeBuffer(const char (&buf)[N])
methods.description: Template constructor for character array buffers.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has been fully consumed.

methods.name: HasData
methods.description: Checks if there is remaining data to decode.

methods.name: Remaining
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes remaining to decode.

methods.name: Offset
methods.description: Returns the current cursor offset from the start of the buffer.

methods.name: FullSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the buffer.

methods.name: MinLengthRemaining
methods.description: Returns the minimum of a specified length and remaining bytes.

methods.name: cursor
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the current decoding position.

methods.name: AdvanceCursor
methods.description: Advances the cursor by a specified amount.

methods.name: DecodeChar
methods.description: Decodes a single character/byte from the buffer.
